messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — NexaSearch just escalated. Since last night's search rollout (~21:10 UTC) their results are much worse for knowledge-base queries: poorer grounding, missing doc citations, and lower recall. They're on Tier 2 and want a quick triage.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: prod-search v1.43 -> v1.44 at 2026-03-16T21:08:32Z (deploy-id d-9876).
james_support: Can you drop a couple of concrete failing queries + request IDs? Also which customer contact should we loop in?
maria_cs: POC is anna@nexasearch. Examples: 
1) q="how to reset service api key" — expected top hit: KB article KB-542, observed: generic blog post, no citation. req_id=req-33aef7
2) q="payment webhook retry" — expected doc DOC-19, observed unrelated forum result. req_id=req-33af10
Here is the response snippet from their API:
```json
{"query":"how to reset service api key","results":[{"title":"Resetting API Keys","source":null,"snippet":"... use dashboard..."}]}
```
james_support: Thanks. @sophie_eng any idea what in v1.44 could cause citation loss?
sophie_eng: Two quick suspects: 1) embedding encoder swap (different vector space => low recall), 2) ranking model change that deprioritizes exact-match anchors. Can someone check index snapshot/completion and embedding model used during rollout?
raj_infra: Checking metrics now — p@5 for NexaSearch queries dropped from 0.82 -> 0.55 starting at 2026-03-16T21:09:00Z. Embedding norms mean shifted from 0.87 -> 0.61 across that window. Looks like the embedding model in the rollout is a quantized/lightweight variant.
sophie_eng: Can you paste the rollout config? I want to see if embed-model was switched.
raj_infra: Config from deployment: 
```yaml
service: prod-search
version: v1.44
components:
  embedder: small-encoder-quant-v2
  ranker: hybrid-concat-mlp-v3
indexing:
  snapshot: sn-2026-03-16-20:50
  background_reindex: true
```
sophie_eng: Bingo — small-encoder-quant-v2 is not compatible with the previous index's vector space. Background reindex was enabled but snapshot predated the push. That mismatch could break nearest-neighbor recall.
maria_cs: Customer says they saw the drop immediately after their first requests post-deploy. They have production traffic, uptime constraints.
james_support: Short-term mitigation: rollback to v1.43 or pin embedder to the previous encoder (small-encoder-v1) and restart ranker. Long-term: we need migration plan for embedding swaps + index re-embedding.
raj_infra: I'm initiating rollback to v1.43 now (triggered). ETA ~10-15m. Rolling back embedder + ranker and restoring node pool. Monitor link: https://ops.internal/rollouts/d-9876/rollback
sophie_eng: After rollback we'll schedule a controlled reindex: create new index snapshot, run offline re-embed with small-encoder-quant-v2, validate with evaluation prompt set (recall/anchor checks), then can re-deploy with canary. I'll open an internal task and add the eval checklist.
maria_cs: I'll update NexaSearch: letting them know we're rolling back and will follow up with a root-cause update + timeline.
james_support: Creating incident INC-2026-45, adding Nexa contact, assigned to @sophie_eng and @raj_infra.
sophie_eng: Quick note for the postmortem — we need gating: require index-snapshot >= deployment.timestamp if embedder variant changes.
raj_infra: Rollback completed at 2026-03-16T21:20:05Z. p@5 climbing back to 0.79 — continuing to monitor.
maria_cs: Amazing, thanks. I'll close the loop with the customer and escalate any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
